scope: v2: recommendation consistency + tone + sample-vs-total + hedged-vs-asserted

findings.message: The 'Summary of Findings' closing paragraph switches from the consistent third-person voice used throughout the report body to first-person ('We invite the team to review'), while every other narrative paragraph in that section and surrounding sections uses third-person constructions.
findings.context: We invite the team to review the findings that follow and prioritise the steps that will extend that foundation to machine audiences.

findings.message: The Structured Data Inventory section asserts 'a wider audit identifies the same gaps across the rest of the estate' — an unscoped claim that extrapolates the 12-page sample finding to the full site without qualification.
findings.context: a wider audit identifies the same gaps across the rest of the estate.

findings.message: The Cross-Page Consistency table reports 'Skip link: 0% — 12 pages missing it', stated with certainty across all 12 audited pages, but the Marker Reachability table on the same report records 'Skip link (accessibility): Yes / Yes / Body / Yes / No', directly contradicting the certainty of a 0% skip-link finding.
